title: Daily Double 7: buy a 7-day closing low above the 200-day mean, sell a 7-day closing high

source.title: Larry Connors' Double 7 Strategy: Tested on SPY and 8 Other Markets

rule_summary: Daily signals from closed daily candles built from the 1h data; orders executed at the next 1h open. Long only, one position per pair, whole balance. ENTRY when a daily close is above the 200-day simple moving average of daily closes AND that close is less than or equal to the lowest daily close of the last 7 days (including the current day) AND no position is open. EXIT when a daily close is greater than or equal to the highest daily close of the last 7 days (including the current day). No stop, no profit target, no time exit. Lookbacks: 7 days for entry channel, 7 days for exit channel, 200 days for the trend filter.
mechanism: Counterparty: short-horizon sellers who capitulate or de-risk after a few down days inside a long-term uptrend, pushing price below fair value for a short time; liquidity-demanding panic sellers pay a premium to exit. Short-term reversal after a pullback is paid to the buyer who supplies liquidity. The source gives no mechanism beyond the stock-index mean reversion observation; this is the closest honest one.
